title: TypeSomething two-tone wordmark
description: A wordmark in two weights: a bold first half and a light second half in the brand colour, closed by an underscore cursor and an optional small icon. The second half can type itself out and erase on a loop.
notes: the tail uses primary as a text colour: on the TypeSomething theme it's a very light acid green, faithful but low-contrast on white
typing needs JavaScript (hydrate); the static HTML shows the full name
name: typesomething-wordmark

props.name: lead
props.description: the bold first half of the name (e.g. "Paper")

props.name: tail
props.description: the second half, set light in the brand colour (e.g. "kite")

props.name: icon
props.description: a small mark after the name (a lucide icon, an svg or an img)

props.name: typing
props.description: the second half types itself and erases on a loop, behind a blinking cursor

props.name: cursor
props.description: the cursor glyph shown after the name; empty for none
